messages:
Nora L: starting int4 canary for `marlin-mini` with parse_granularity="token". low latency but seeing funcall arg fragments causing JSON lint failures.
Tim J: paste one example and your config?
Nora L: config:
```json
{"model":"marlin-mini-int4","parse_granularity":"token","suffix_heal":false}
```
example chunks:
chunk1: "..."args":"{\"order\":\"o-77\",\"qty\":2"
chunk2: "}","meta":{}}
Amit R: parser hits EOF on the args string. propose opt-in `suffix_heal=append_closers` that only adds closing braces/brackets/quote, never adds commas/keys. simple heuristic, low risk.
Zoe P: add unit tests for negative cases (missing comma) so we don't accidentally invent structure. Also gate by canary percent.
validator-bot: quick stats: token mode parse_fail=0.62% p50=102ms p95=260ms; block parse_fail=0.17% p50=170ms p95=420ms
Tim J: OK. Amit, please send a small PR implementing append_closers + tests. Nora will run 2% canary and post metrics.
Nora L: will do. tagging infra @oncall for rollout window.
